planting.note: Plant container-grown transplants or pups in spring in well-drained, sandy soil in full sun to partial shade; Bright Edge is a variegated selection of native Adam's needle yucca with bold gold margins along each blue-green leaf, the reverse pattern from the central-striped Color Guard cultivar.

directions: Plant in well-drained, sandy to average soil in full sun to partial shade. Bright Edge is a variegated form of the native Adam's needle yucca, each stiff, sword-shaped, evergreen leaf edged in a bright golden-yellow margin around a blue-green center, providing bold architectural color in the landscape year-round in addition to the tall summer spikes of white, bell-shaped flowers. Like the species it is extremely drought-tolerant, salt-tolerant, and adaptable to poor, sandy, or coastal soils once established, needing almost no supplemental water or care. It slowly forms offsets (pups) at the base that can be separated to propagate new plants, and old flower stalks can be cut down after the blooms fade.
